d: Platinum white hair falls in long, straight layers with bangs sweeping across the forehead. Narrow, pale grey eyes carry a vacant expression on a face with the maturity of a young adult. The build is slender, wearing a high-collared, oversized red hooded cloak over a dark undergarment, paired with a black rectangular sign held by a gloved hand. The legs and feet are a pale lavender-grey, covered in a network of dark, jagged cracks resembling broken porcelain. BODY COLOR: Pale lavender-grey LEGS: Plantigrade, with five-toed human-style feet.
